author: Netanyahu
quote: 13 years, $2B budget and $80 price tag on the game just to deliver this trash game. Legit boring nothing like a gta game can even rob a car until chapter 2 like what is this? It was about shooting, chaos, robbing with gang not painting walls, fixing pipelines and pressing R2 and holding lucia’s hand. So overhyped on internet cuz of the simps who only wanna see the strip club and lucia’s jugs, very disappointing with the gameplay. Not worth the wait, money and playtime
